q14408171.question: R2-1 owner choice: accept manual-only recovery guidance with no operation.lock or all-consumer shutdown proof/enforcement during an operator move, or request a separately designed control-owned recovery command? Proposed default is manual-only with the exact diagnostic in §4.3.
q14408171.choice: Manual-only recovery guidance, without enforced locking or all-consumer shutdown proof; accept the disclosed concurrency risk, use the exact root-write/no-deletion diagnostic and retain the recovery-command follow-up for consideration before general release.
q14408171.rationale: User explicitly approved LLD8 with manual-only recovery guidance and corrected read-only runtime plus writable SDK isolation in this turn.
